description: This file defines a Spring Data repository interface for accessing 'Account' data in a banking application. It extends CrudRepository to provide basic CRUD operations and declares a custom method to find accounts by account number.

classes.name: AccountRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data repository interface for 'Account' entities, providing CRUD operations and a custom finder method.

methods.name: findByAccountNumber
methods.description: Retrieves an Optional containing the Account with the specified account number.
